assumptions: piSignage player API potentially accepts or shares default Raspberry Pi OS credentials for low-privilege user authentication

evidence_quotes.quote: The web application component of piSignage before 2.6.4 allows a remote attacker (authenticated as a low-privilege user) to download arbitrary files from the Raspberry Pi via api/settings/log?file=../ path traversal.
